# DigiRobotics - LLM Context File

## Project Overview
DigiRobotics is an agentic commerce marketplace for Physical AI training data, built on Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4
- Backend: Node.js, Express, x402 protocol
- Blockchain: Arbitrum Sepolia (421614), Robinhood Chain Testnet (46630)
- Smart Contracts: Solidity 0.8.24, Foundry
- Wallets: Thirdweb Embedded Wallets, ZeroDev (ERC-4337)
- Storage: IPFS/Pinata (Telegram capture prototype)
- Payments: MockUSDG (mUSDG) test stablecoin on both testnets; USDG and PYUSD planned for mainnet
- Hosting: Cloudflare Workers

## Key Features
1. Zero-friction onboarding (email/Google → embedded wallet)
2. x402 agentic payments (HTTP 402 + EIP-3009)
3. RWA tokenization (ERC-721/1155 for datasets) (planned)
4. Multi-chain support (Arbitrum, Robinhood)
5. Global stablecoin payouts (planned)

## x402 Payment Rail
- Asset: MockUSDG (mUSDG), EIP-3009, 6 decimals
- Networks: Arbitrum Sepolia (421614), Robinhood Chain Testnet (46630)
- MockUSDG: 0xBbB4155d20D739faABC3af41A3344FAEfD76dDD4 (same address on both networks)
- X402Facilitator: 0xB7D6F2aC244C8562CEd113AAf1a1A41C253FE816 (same address on both networks)
- Live x402 server: https://x402.digirobotics.xyz (configured for Arbitrum Sepolia)

## Repository Structure
- /web: Next.js frontend
- /x402-server: Backend agent and payment processing
- /contracts: Solidity smart contracts (Foundry)
- /docs: Technical documentation

## Getting Started
```bash
cd web && npm install && npm run dev
cd x402-server && npm install && npm run dev
cd contracts && forge build
```

- README.md: Project overview
- web/docs/ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_SETUP.md: Robinhood Chain integration
- x402-server/docs/AGENT_DEMO_RUNBOOK.md: x402 agent demo guide
